source.protocol: SUMO, 3,600 s episode, 3 seeds per condition
source.notes: CoLight, CityLight and PressLight use the 2026-11 optimised protocol (100 training rounds, checkpoint selected on held-out seed 0, evaluated on benchmark seeds 1-3). MPLight, AdvancedDQN and AttendLight remain on the fixed-feature reruns. Max Pressure is the published pressure controller.
